title: SiGMA Central Europe B2C Awards 2025 — In Pictures
excerpt: The night in pictures: networking, celebrations, and well-earned recognitions from the SiGMA Central Europe B2C Awards 2025.
introHtml:
The night in pictures: networking, celebrations, and well-earned recognitions. Words can describe the SiGMA Central Europe B2C Awards 2025 only so far — the photos do the rest.

This post is a short visual diary of the evening, with a few notes on what each moment really meant for the team behind the scenes.

sections.title: Before the Ceremony
sections.bodyHtml:
The hours before the ceremony are usually the calmest part of the night. Last-minute logistics, quiet check-ins with the team, a few photos in the lobby, and a shared list of operators we wanted to find on-site.

It is also the moment when most of the small surprises get planned — the ones that turn a routine event into a memorable one for the people who travelled with us.

subsections.title: Small details we look for in the build-up:
subsections.bodyHtml:
• Clear signage and a quick partner check-in flow
  • A short briefing for the team about category timings
  • A simple plan for who chats with which operator
  • A quiet corner reserved for in-depth conversations

sections.title: After the Last Award
sections.bodyHtml:
The post-ceremony hour is where the real value lives — partners are relaxed, conversations get more honest, and follow-ups stop being polite and start being concrete. Several roadmap items for the next quarter were sketched on napkins that night.

For more on what we are building together with these partners, the central hub remains affiliate.makeberry.com.
